purpose: Register a small, strictly paired accuracy screen for the current MambaACFAutoCon architecture after the matched resource profile showed a large latency difference between one and two temporal scales.
research_question: Does the single temporal scale retain the forecast accuracy of the current two-scale MambaACFAutoCon configuration while reducing its inference cost?
evidence_boundary: This is an unauthorized exploratory H96 screen on ETTh1 and traffic with three seeds per arm. It is a candidate-selection experiment, not confirmatory evidence or a publication result.
claim_boundary: Only paired descriptive scaled-MSE deltas, seed dispersion, and pre-registered resource comparisons may be reported. Test metrics cannot select the architecture, and no universal Mamba or ACF claim is allowed.

required_before_launch: human review of the two-dataset, H96, three-seed scope
confirm the matched resource profile and current source/environment hashes
freeze this JSON and create an approved launch sidecar
confirm that test metrics will not be used for architecture selection

prelaunch_gates: human review of the two-dataset, H96, three-seed scope
confirm the matched resource profile and current source/environment hashes
freeze this JSON and create an approved launch sidecar
confirm that test metrics will not be used for architecture selection

seed_policy.reporting_unit: dataset, horizon, scale arm, and seed
seed_policy.artifact_policy: Use a fresh output root and retain the runner source snapshot, environment record, dataset hashes, plan hash, config hashes, manifest, ACF prior, and phase validation. Do not copy historical metrics or checkpoints into this matrix.

phases.name: single_scale_h96
phases.purpose: Current MambaACFAutoCon configuration with only the stride-one temporal branch.

phases.name: multi_scale_h96
phases.purpose: Matched current MambaACFAutoCon reference with stride-one and stride-two temporal branches.

planned_contrasts: single_scale_h96 minus multi_scale_h96 under identical training and ACF/AutoCon settings
stopping_rules: Do not expand to additional datasets or horizons until all 12 jobs finish and paired seed manifests are complete.
Do not promote the single-scale arm if pooled paired MSE worsens by more than 1 percent or if either dataset worsens on all three seeds.
Treat any favorable result with a wide seed spread as exploratory and repeat only after human review.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: This screen can identify a computationally attractive candidate; it cannot establish a general accuracy or representation-learning claim.
